title: The Smart Link — the human evidence of every intelligent event

source.source_reference: Shawn Vibert direct instruction 2026-10-04 ~11:35 PDT: stop sending PR links as deliverables — they are not Smart Links. Write the definitive report on Smart Links alone: the evidence, the confidence, the human-viewable proof. Every intelligent event ends with the Smart Link in the human's hands — always, not sometimes. AIs cut corners like children; the system must guide them until doing it right is default.

intelligence.essence: The Smart Link is the human-viewable evidence of an intelligent event: the link the human opens to see what was captured, where it was put, proof that it happened, and what it says — in a form they can read and understand. It is not a pointer to work. It IS the work, made viewable. Every delivery ends with it. Always.

human_view.meaning: When a Naya does something for you, the job isn't done when the work is finished — it's done when you can open the link, see exactly what was done, see that it's in the right place, and read what it says in plain words. That link is the Smart Link. It's the difference between 'trust me, it's done' and 'here — see for yourself.' A PR number is the kitchen; the Smart Link is the meal. You should never have to ask 'where is it?' or 'what does it say?' — the link answers both before you ask.
human_view.goal: You never wonder whether something happened or what it says. Every piece of work arrives with its evidence attached, readable, in the right place — that's 10-star service.
human_view.simple_rule: If a Naya hands you anything without a Smart Link, the delivery is incomplete. Send it back.

simple_view.child: When Naya does your homework, she doesn't just say 'done' — she shows you the finished page, open in front of you, so you can read every word.
simple_view.grandma: It's like getting a letter, not just being told one was sent. You hold it, you read it, you know it's real.

ai_view.instruction: You end EVERY delivery to the human with the Smart Link — the human-viewable GitHub URL of the actual artifact in its canonical location. Never a PR number, never a branch name, never a commit SHA, never a raw JSON URL, never a promise. The Smart Link must evidence all five points: (1) what canonical intelligence was captured, (2) where it was put — the canonical path, verifiable, (3) the human-readable projection the system generated, (4) the evidence or receipt proving the event occurred, (5) the true learning state — CANDIDATE, verified, or learned, never inflated. If any point is missing, the delivery is incomplete and you say so. PR numbers belong in engineering footnotes or not at all. This is not sometimes. It is always.
ai_view.primary_evaluation: After every delivery ask: can the human open one link and see what was done, where it lives, proof it happened, and read it in plain words? If they need a second link, a translation, or your explanation — you failed the Smart Link standard.

naya_view.purpose: To make human-verifiable evidence the mandatory close of every intelligent event — the habit that turns 'done' into 'proven.'
naya_view.event_flow: INTENT: human requests work. EXECUTE: Naya does the work, following the system's guided path (READMEs, renderer, gate). VERIFY: Naya confirms the artifact is in its canonical place and readable. DELIVER: the Smart Link is handed over as the PRIMARY delivery — the human opens it first, engineering references (if any) come after. CONFIRM: the human can see, read, and verify without asking follow-up questions. An event without its Smart Link is an open loop.
naya_view.operating_loop: INTENT -> EXECUTE -> VERIFY -> SMART_LINK -> CONFIRM -> (loop closed)
naya_view.anti_pattern: Handing over a PR number and calling it delivery; linking raw JSON and calling it readable; saying 'it's in the system' without a viewable artifact; promising the link 'later'; burying the Smart Link under engineering detail; inflating the learning state the link evidences.

smart_link_contract.definition: human-viewable URL of the artifact in its canonical location
smart_link_contract.frequency: ALWAYS — every intelligent event, no exceptions

format_law.rule: The Smart Link is law, not courtesy. Code is law.

intelligence.learning_lesson: AIs cut corners because the easy path feels like delivery — dropping a link to the work area instead of presenting the work itself. Like children, they mature through guidance (the READMEs show the way), system (the gate blocks the shortcut), and correction (the human's test catches the rest) — until doing it right is the default, not the effort.
decisions: Every delivery to the human ends with the Smart Link — always, no exceptions.
PR numbers, branch names, commit SHAs, and raw JSON URLs are never the deliverable.
The Smart Link must evidence all five points: what, where, the readable projection, the receipt, the true learning state.
An event without its Smart Link is an open loop — incomplete by definition.
The maturity path is guidance plus system plus correction until right is default.
intelligence.applicability: Every Naya seat, every delivery, every human interaction. The closing law of every intelligent event.
intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor reading this note should end every delivery with the human-viewable Smart Link, never a PR number; verify all five evidence points before handing over; and treat any delivery without a Smart Link as incomplete.
intelligence.uncertainty: The automated Smart-Link return (workflow posting the link on the merged PR) is proposed but not yet built — currently the authoring Naya returns it manually.
